_comment: Nightly full reconciliation of users at 02:15, server time (WS9.02, runbook §4). Resource types run before subject types (accounts at 01:15, users at 02:15), so a user's relationships find their accounts already in the service and are not dropped. Thread count is the mapping's taskThreads (4). Adjust the times so they do not overlap other heavy jobs, and so one finishes before the next starts (50,000 users took under 3 minutes against an in-memory stand-in at 4 threads, WS8.11; add about one service round trip per entity divided by the thread count, and measure it in the dry run, runbook §4).
